draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.85, the 196th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 24th of 36 at CB. He went 202nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 9 passes defended in 2022, 11th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 23 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (1 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile), season snap share 14.5% (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 14.5% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
